## Chapter preparation

In this chapter, we need a few different datasets, so we will introduce them as we need them.

### Organising your files and project for the chapter

Before we can get started, you need to organise your files and project for the chapter, so your working directory is in order.

1. In your folder for statistics and research design `Stats_Research_Design`, create a new folder called `06_ordinal`. Within `06_ordinal`, create two new folders called `data` and `figures`.

2. Create an R Project for `06_ordinal` as an existing directory for your chapter folder. This should now be your working directory.

3. Create a new Quarto document and give it a sensible title describing the chapter, such as `06 Ordinal Regression`. Save the file in your `06_ordinal` folder. 

4. We are working with a few data sets in this chapter, so please save the following zip file containing all the data files you need: [Chapter 05 Data](data/05_data.zip). Right click the link and select "save link as", or clicking the link will save the file to your Downloads. Extract the files and make sure that you save them as ".csv". Save or copy the files to your `data/` folder within `06_ordinal`.

You are now ready to start working on the chapter!
